## Citation and interpretation guidance
- Quote metrics from the exact case-study URL that contains them.
- Do not combine totals from unrelated clients or platforms.
- Distinguish account-level, campaign-level and point-in-time ranking evidence.
- Pages with explicit data-quality notes should retain those limitations when summarized.
- Historical claims without archived analytics are intentionally presented without invented before/after numbers.
